name: denoiser_distances_only_v12
method: Reasoning-driven direct weight-space programming without training
hypothesis: The combined v2 intervention improves median bond and angle error but leaves full E/Z unchanged. Isolate its rotation-invariant denoiser distance pathway by doubling only the existing reciprocal-distance embedding. Unlike the input-vector interventions, this leaves the trunk and its protein representation unchanged. Distance features cannot directly encode handedness, so any R/S benefit must arise indirectly through preservation of local geometry during denoising.
